name: telperion
description: A procedural tree generator. Authored silhouette, space colonization continued by local rules down to leaf-bearing twigs, conserved thickness, one continuous plaited surface, and foliage culled to a shell and drawn one indirect draw per level of detail, each leaf at the coarsest level a pixel cannot tell from the finest.
author: Daniel Killenberger

scripts.dev: npm run wasm:build && npm run render:build && vite
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && npm run render:build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build
scripts.pretest: npm run wasm:build && npm run render:build
scripts.rust:build: cargo build --release --workspace && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p telperion-wasm
scripts.species:measure: cargo build --release -p telperion-core --example species_measure && node tests/species.mjs --measure-only
scripts.species:qa: cargo build --release -p telperion-core --example species_measure && cargo build --release -p telperion-render --example headless && node tests/species.mjs
